summary: Validated Bloc 4 (Affinda EU real integration) + Bloc 3bis (Suivi manuel des candidatures) end-to-end. Backend pytest 25/25 pass (5 new tests: Affinda availability with detected fields + full ApplicationCreate/list/filter/update/download(cv+letter PDF)/delete). Frontend Playwright 5-block flow passed with real API on preview URL: Bloc4 shows 'Analyse effectuée par l'API professionnelle Affinda.' banner (affinda_available=true), Bloc5 save-application dialog is prefilled from job analysis (poste='Développeur Fullstack Senior', entreprise='Acme Corp'), row appears in /applications with 'entretien' badge, status-filter excludes non-matching entries, quick-status changed to 'acceptée', edit dialog saves poste, dl-cv-<id> returned 3086B PDF, dl-letter-<id> returned 3080B PDF (snapshot rebuild works), delete + confirm removes the row and empty-state is shown.
critical_code_review_comments: Affinda EU wiring is correct: ats_service.affinda_parse uses AFFINDA_BASE_URL (api.eu1.affinda.com), passes wait=true, and deletes the uploaded doc post-parsing (RGPD) — verified live on preview and via pytest (affinda_available=true, source=affinda).
ats_service still has zero LLM imports (assertion in test_ats_service_has_no_llm_import) — Bloc 4 remains purely ATS parsing, no Claude latency.

Applications router does snapshot correctly (final_cv + cover_letter.paragraphs) and rebuilds PDF/DOCX from the snapshot on download — verified with a delete of the source CV path would still work (documents are rebuilt in-memory from snapshot).

Small UX nit (non-blocking): the download buttons in Applications.jsx disable via `disabled={downloading}` which uses a string; while it works for empty vs. non-empty, a boolean flag would be cleaner. Not a bug.

Minor: navbar-applications-btn correctly wired; open-save-application-btn / save-application-btn / go-to-tracking-btn / status-filter / quick-status-<id> / edit-<id> / save-edit-btn / delete-app-<id> / confirm-delete-app-<id> / dl-cv-<id> / dl-letter-<id> testids all present and functional.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — every application created by Playwright/backend_test is deleted by the same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Affinda EU key is live and the response is fast (<5s). The application snapshot embeds cover_letter.paragraphs from the session; if a session had no letter, /applications/{id}/download with doc_type=cover_letter would 400 — behavior confirmed only for happy path. Testids to reuse: navbar-applications-btn, open-save-application-btn, save-application-btn, go-to-tracking-btn, status-filter, quick-status-<id>, edit-<id>, save-edit-btn, delete-app-<id>, confirm-delete-app-<id>, dl-cv-<id>, dl-letter-<id>. The CV file input has data-testid='upload-cv-input' and is display:hidden — use set_input_files with state='attached'.
rca of the issue: N/A — both requested features (A) Affinda real EU integration and (B) manual application tracking are correctly implemented and verified. No regression on the async 2-LLM generation flow (Sonnet CV + Haiku letter).
